def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    nz=[[1 if grid[i][j] else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    best=0;pos=None
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            k=1
            while i+k<=h and j+k<=w and all(nz[a][b] for a in range(i,i+k) for b in range(j,j+k)): k+=1
            if k-1>best: best=k-1; pos=(i,j)
    s=best-2
    c=grid[pos[0]+best//2][pos[1]+best//2]
    return [[c]*s for _ in range(s)]
assert transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(json.dumps(transform(G['Test input'])))
